name: Low-rank key projection and KV compression: research-only vs deployed
arithmetic_intensity: Low-rank key projection and KV compression aim to reduce the KV cache by projecting to a lower-dimensional space. MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) is the deployed extreme of this: it compresses K and V JOINTLY through one shared down-projection W_DKV, so every head's K and V live in the same d_c-dimensional subspace. MLA is deployed in DeepSeek-V2/V3/V4. GQA/MQA reduce cache by reducing KV head count - GQA is universally deployed, MQA is widely used. Low-rank key projection (separate from MLA) is research-only: no production engine ships a general low-rank KV projection. KV quantization (fp8/int8/int4) is deployed: FlashMLA supports fp8/fp4 KV cache on Blackwell. KV compression via token merging (e.g., PyramidKV, SnapKV, H2O) is research-only: they reduce the number of cached tokens but require a selection pass and are not in production engines.
scales_with: kv_lora_rank d_c (MLA cache elements per token)
workarounds: MLA: compress K and V jointly through shared down-projection (deployed in DeepSeek)
GQA: reduce KV head count (universally deployed)
KV quantization: fp8/fp4/int8 KV cache (deployed in FlashMLA on Blackwell)
notes: Deployment status summary: DEPLOYED: MLA (DeepSeek-V2/V3/V4), GQA (most modern models), MQA (many models), KV quantization (fp8 in FlashMLA, int8/int4 in various engines). RESEARCH-ONLY: low-rank key projection (general), token merging (PyramidKV, SnapKV, H2O), NSA, DSA (only in DeepSeek-V3.2 with FlashMLA), YOCO, RetNet, Kimi Linear. The key insight: MLA is the only low-rank compression that is deployed because it preserves quality while achieving 85x cache reduction. GQA/MQA are deployed because they are simple and preserve quality. Token merging and general low-rank projection lose quality and are not in production. SageAttention is NOT in vLLM or SGLang LLM serving path - it is research-only. Sources: arch-deepseek-v2-mla, arch-nsa, arch-retnet, arch-kimi-linear, kern-flashmla-github.
